title: Source-bound scheduled irrigation TCS7/DCS2 table semantics
protocol: PIN_B1_11_SOURCE -> RECONCILE_TYPED_EVALUATOR -> FIX_AFGEN_ENDPOINT_SEMANTICS -> SOURCE_ORACLE -> O0_O2_REPLAY -> HOLD_PRODUCTION_ADMISSION

source.lineage: The archive is the B0 distribution source; B1.11 adds SWAP-011, whose ordered patch does not target either file. Therefore these files are unchanged in the corrected B1.11 source tree.

scope: DCS=2 source amount 0.1 * AFGEN(fidtab,14,DVS) in cm
partial 14-entry table sentinel, first-value lower clamp and last-value upper clamp
piecewise-linear interpolation and 100,000 deterministic scheduled-event comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: generic management parser or event-calendar ingestion
SSDI runtime admission, solute coupling or hydraulic source booking
changes to F-APP07 admitted Hupsel TCS1/DCS2 application
new persistent state owner, restart schema or production admission
pass_conditions: source AFGEN oracle preserves lower clamp, piecewise-linear source arithmetic and partial-table upper clamp
vectors exercise interpolation within the active table range and clamping above/below it
typed evaluator matches TCS7 trigger and DCS2 depth over 100,000 deterministic inputs
trigger equality and non-trigger sides are covered
triggered SSDI event amount and split duration are consistent with the selected depth
